title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
plot_overview: After years of taking life easy, a laid-back man learns that his longtime girlfriend is nearing the end of her pregnancy. With a new responsibility ahead, he travels to America to revive his former success, where he faces challenges that put his future family at risk.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like irreverent comedy, outrageous situations, and a comeback story with family stakes; Not for you if crude humor or broad satire isn’t your style.
review_summary: Pros: irreverent comedy; outrageous premise; transatlantic adventure | Cons: crude humor; broad satire; familiar comeback plot
